body.construction: Construct \(\widehat\tau_n(0)\) by sample splitting, an annular boundary local-polynomial R-equation, finite-dimensional empirical projection U-statistic corrections indexed by the separately optimized nuisance orders, spectral flooring of every empirical Gram matrix, clipping to \([-3/4,3/4]\), and a deterministic fallback on every exceptional dataset; all coefficients are sample moments and finite matrix operations.
